findings.doctrine: Text(date, style: .relative), .timer, and .offset styles, which re-render on their own schedule.
findings.claim: Four timestamps use Text(date, style: .relative) and repaint every second (queue age '3 min, 2 sec ago' DetailsWindow.swift:244, host 'observed 2 sec ago' DetailsWindow.swift:142, panel 'GitHub 2 sec ago' MenuBarViews.swift:58, plan review expiry DetailsWindow.swift:305).
findings.expectedFix: Format each date as a String inside body, for example date.formatted(.relative(presentation: .numeric, unitsStyle: .abbreviated)), so it changes only when the store publishes new state; show the plan expiry as an absolute time (reviewedAt + lifetime, formatted .dateTime.hour().minute()).

findings.doctrine: Indefinite ProgressView() (spinner or bar). Show static state text or a static symbol.
findings.claim: The plan review window (opened by plan buttons like this one) shows an indefinite ProgressView spinner while a plan runs (DetailsWindow.swift:313); source only, untested at runtime because demo mode disables plans.
findings.expectedFix: Replace ProgressView() with static text, for example Label("Running", systemImage: "hourglass"), shown while store.runningPlanID == plan.id.

findings.claim: With zero findings the menu bar glyph falls through to circle.dotted, the same symbol as 'not loaded yet', and its accessibility label is only 'Little CI', so a healthy fleet looks and reads like an app that never loaded (MenuBarViews.swift:37-43; Assessment.worstSeverity is nil when findings are empty).
findings.expectedFix: Choose the symbol from store.state first: no state gives circle.dotted (or questionmark.circle with a setup problem), a loaded state with no findings gives checkmark.circle; set the label to name that state, for example 'Little CI: all clear', 'Little CI: 4 critical findings', 'Little CI: reading'.

findings.measurement: panel-plan-button: fail, 152.5 x 16 pt, minimum 20 x 20 pt (apple-target-macos); runners-plan-button: fail, 131.5 x 16 pt
findings.claim: Plan buttons use .controlSize(.small) and measure 16 pt tall, below the 20 pt macOS minimum, in the panel and in every pane (MenuBarViews.swift:141, DetailsWindow.swift:107, DetailsWindow.swift:209).
findings.expectedFix: Remove .controlSize(.small) from the three plan-button HStacks so they use the regular 20 pt control size.

findings.claim: Severity and service-level symbols carry state but have no accessibility label, so VoiceOver hears a symbol name or nothing instead of 'critical', 'warning', 'met' or 'missed' (MenuBarViews.swift:110, MenuBarViews.swift:129, DetailsWindow.swift:274).
findings.expectedFix: Add .accessibilityLabel(finding.severity.rawValue) to the FindingRow and Events severity images, and .accessibilityLabel(level.met == nil ? "not measured" : level.met! ? "met" : "missed") to the ServiceLevelGrid image; verify with VoiceOver.

findings.claim: The orange demo label is 2.0:1 in light appearance, below 3:1 for bold text, in the Details banner (DetailsWindow.swift:30) and the panel 'DEMO DATA' label (MenuBarViews.swift:55); orange also already means 'warning' elsewhere.
findings.expectedFix: Drop .foregroundStyle(.orange) from both demo labels and keep them bold in the primary label color (13.2:1 measured for primary text on the same background).

findings.claim: In light appearance the orange warning triangle (2.01:1) and the green 'met' check (1.87:1) fall below 3:1 against the panel; shape still carries the meaning, so the impact is low.
findings.expectedFix: Tint met service levels .secondary instead of .green (MenuBarViews.swift:111) so only misses carry color, and recheck the warning triangle with Increase Contrast on.

findings.claim: The system-drawn sidebar selection, while the sidebar lacks keyboard focus, puts white text on gray at 2.39:1 in light and 3.83:1 in dark.
findings.expectedFix: No app change: this is the standard unfocused List selection. Recheck with Increase Contrast on; keep the sidebar a standard List.

findings.claim: The menu bar extra is the only way into the app: a plain launch opened no window, the Details window is suppressed at launch (LittleCIApp.swift:29), there is no Dock icon, and nothing handles a reopen, so a hidden extra (notch overflow or a menu bar manager, as on this Mac) leaves no path to Details.
findings.expectedFix: Add an NSApplicationDelegateAdaptor whose applicationShouldHandleReopen opens the details window, so opening the app again from Finder or Spotlight shows Details.

findings.claim: The compact service-level grid truncates names and values ('Time to detect a dead run…', 'median 14 min, p90 26 min…') with no way to read the rest in the panel (MenuBarViews.swift:112-113).
findings.expectedFix: Add .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true) to Text(level.name) and Text(level.measured) in ServiceLevelGrid so long cells wrap to a second line.

findings.claim: In demo mode the panel's plan buttons, Refresh and the lend checkbox are dimmed with no reason; only the Details window says plans are disabled (MenuBarViews.swift:55, MenuBarViews.swift:92, MenuBarViews.swift:160).
findings.expectedFix: Change the panel label to Text("Demo data: plans are off") and add .help("Plans are off while demo data is on.") to PlanButton and Refresh when store.isDemo.

findings.claim: In the plan review window, Cancel only clears store.review and leaves the window open showing 'No plan under review.' (DetailsWindow.swift:311, DetailsWindow.swift:324); source only, untested at runtime.
findings.expectedFix: Read @Environment(\.dismiss) in PlanReviewWindow and call dismiss() after store.review = nil in the Cancel action.

findings.claim: Run is the default button (Return) in the plan review window, also for irreversible plans such as cancel runs and retire, so one stray Return runs the plan (DetailsWindow.swift:315); source only, untested at runtime.
findings.expectedFix: Remove .keyboardShortcut(.defaultAction) from Run and keep Cancel on .cancelAction, so running needs a click or Tab then Space.

findings.claim: The Details window title is 'Little CI' on every pane; the title never names the pane (no navigationTitle in DetailsWindow.swift).
findings.expectedFix: Add .navigationTitle(pane.rawValue) to the detail column in DetailsWindow so the title reads Overview, Hosts, Runners, Queue or Events.

findings.claim: A host with no probe result shows no facts and no status line (Studio VM, Hetzner), and the Runners pane shows their service as 'unknown' with no reason (DetailsWindow.swift:101-104, DetailsWindow.swift:185).
findings.expectedFix: Add a branch after line 104: if observation == nil { Text("No probe result yet.").font(.callout) }.

findings.claim: Swap reads 'Zero KB of Zero KB' (ByteCountFormatter's zero), and fact labels mix lowercase ('load', 'swap', 'disk', 'observed') with capitalized ('Docker', 'Compose') (DetailsWindow.swift:128-146, 156-159).
findings.expectedFix: In FactsGrid.swap (DetailsWindow.swift:156-159) return "none" when the swap total is 0, and capitalize the fact labels (Load, Memory free, Swap, Observed, Disk).

findings.claim: The Notifications menu never shows whether a host is paused or until when, and stays enabled in demo mode, where pauseNotifications silently does nothing (DetailsWindow.swift:95-99, FleetStore.swift:78-80).
findings.expectedFix: Title the menu from state.settings.maintenanceUntil[host.id] (for example 'Paused until 14:30', else 'Notifications') and add .disabled(store.isDemo).

findings.claim: Menu items 'Pause for 1 hour' and 'Resume' do not use title-style capitalization, and Resume is enabled when nothing is paused (DetailsWindow.swift:96-97).
findings.expectedFix: Rename to 'Pause for 1 Hour' and disable Resume unless the host has a future maintenanceUntil.

findings.claim: Runner-row plan buttons repeat the runner name and clip it ('Start dem…', 'Retire de…'), and long runner names wrap mid-name ('little-ci-acme-' / 'widgets-vm-1') (DetailsWindow.swift:204, DetailsWindow.swift:209).
findings.expectedFix: In the runner row show verb-only button labels (Start…, Retire…) with the full plan.title as .help and .accessibilityLabel, and add .lineLimit(1).fixedSize() to the runner name.

findings.measurement: queue-run-link: fail, 17.5 x 15 pt, minimum 20 x 20 pt (apple-target-macos)
findings.claim: Every queue row ends in an identical 'run' link (17.5 x 15 pt), so VoiceOver hears 'run' eight times and the two fix/login rows differ only by age; the run number appears only in the finding evidence below (DetailsWindow.swift:246).
findings.expectedFix: Label the link with the run number: Link("#\(entry.run.id)", destination: …) plus .help("Open run #\(entry.run.id) on GitHub").

findings.claim: Raw API codes leak into the UI ('in_progress' DetailsWindow.swift:243, 'pullRequestClosed' from Assessor.swift:417), and lane headings mix case ('main', 'platform and parity', 'perf lanes' next to 'PRs into main', Assessment.swift:156-159).
findings.expectedFix: Show entry.run.status with underscores replaced by spaces, reuse the 'PR closed' wording in Assessor.swift:417, and sentence-case the lane titles ('Platform and parity', 'Performance lanes').

findings.claim: A cleared finding keeps its original severity, so the Events pane draws a red octagon next to 'Cleared: …' and a fixed problem looks active (EventJournal.swift:61, DetailsWindow.swift:274); demo data has no cleared events, so this is from source.
findings.expectedFix: In EventsPane use checkmark.circle tinted .secondary when event.kind == .findingCleared, and the severity symbol otherwise.

findings.claim: An unreachable host reads 'Laptop is away' with raw ssh output as the only detail, and the Hosts pane shows 'Not reached: <ssh error>' with no next step (DetailsWindow.swift:104).
findings.expectedFix: Append a next step to the Hosts line, for example 'Not reached over SSH: <reason>. Check that the host is awake and that ssh <destination> works in batch mode.'

nonFindings.claim: Dense one-line rows with dividers and no card backgrounds follow the design contract.
The window-style menu bar extra is justified by the service grid, multi-line findings and inline plan buttons.
Section headings are primary bold text with no gray subtitle line above them.
Finding evidence in monospaced text is dense but readable and selectable; it is intended diagnostic output.
The Studio checkbox is dimmed only because demo mode disables lending; not a defect outside demo mode.
A plain Grid without card chrome or row striping is correct under the contract.
Absolute event times (Oct 20 at 12:29) do not repaint and match the contract.
A plain launch opened no stray empty 'Review plan' window, although that scene lacks defaultLaunchBehavior(.suppressed).

changes.outcome: They are fixed text ("just now", "3 min. ago") that changes when the fleet state updates; the plan expiry is an absolute time.
